context: Two cafe friends gossip about a tourist incident outside
purpose: Teach: 襲っ/咲き/外人/野郎/クン/ヶ所/はてな/エキサイト

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: さっき店の前で、観光中の外人さんが急に犬に襲って来られてさ。
lines.en: So just now in front of the shop, this foreign tourist got suddenly rushed by a dog.
lines.style: Hushed, immediate energy—the kind of barista voice that leans in slightly. Fresh adrenaline still in it. Matter-of-fact but alive. Speaking as though the person across from her was there too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、大丈夫だったの？心配で胸がはてなマーク状態。
lines.en: Oh no—were they okay? I'm literally so worried right now.
lines.style: Genuine concern breaching the surface. Soft uptake on 「えっ」. Eyes widen slightly. The pause before the second sentence—she's checking her own worry isn't overblown.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 幸い無傷だったんだけど、目撃した田中クンが大エキサイトしてさ。
lines.en: Luckily no one got hurt, but Tanaka-kun who saw the whole thing? Total adrenaline junkie about it.
lines.style: Light, almost amused tone. A small exhale of relief on 「無傷」. Then brightens fractionally at Tanaka—acknowledging his energy without judgment. Conversational and warm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: その犬の飼い主、近くに二ヶ所、別店舗で問題起こしてるって聞いた。
lines.en: Yeah, I heard that dog's owner has already caused problems at two other stores in the area.
lines.style: Drops slightly lower, more serious now. Conspiratorial lean-in energy. Not gossip for fun—this is a pattern she's connecting. Steady, factual underbelly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: マジか、あの野郎、また?もう警察呼ぶレベルだよね。
lines.en: Seriously? That guy again? This is honestly at the point where someone needs to call the police.
lines.style: Frustration surfaces cleanly. Slight edge sharpens on 「マジか」. Not yelling—controlled frustration of someone whose workspace keeps being disrupted. The closing statement lands firm but not angry.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 店先の桜、ようやく咲き始めたのに、ピリピリした気分で見ちゃうわ。
lines.en: The cherry tree out front just started blooming, but now I can't look at it without feeling tense.
lines.style: Quieter pivot. A small, sad note underneath. She's holding something gentle and it's being shadowed. Trailing slightly on 「ピリピリ」—the dissonance bothers her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 落ち着いたら、また一緒にお花見しよ。
lines.en: Once this all settles down, let's go see the cherry blossoms together again.
lines.style: Warm reset. Intentional and caring. A small offering of normalcy. Soft opening, steady middle, quiet promise at the close. The kind of thing that lands because she means it.
